realm_description: The high, thin-aired peaks where thought is clearest. Those drawn here chase vision, discovery, and the kind of knowledge that only comes from climbing higher than everyone else.

primary.label: Strategist
primary.description: Plays the long game; every move is calculated toward winning.
primary.guiding_promise: Every move I make today is setting up tomorrow's victory.
primary.shadow_description: Starts treating the people around them as pieces to be played, not ends in themselves.

secondary.label: Chancellor
secondary.description: The quiet spine behind institutions; translates vision into something that survives contact with reality.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will hold the center so the whole does not fall apart.
secondary.shadow_description: Mistakes holding the center for holding on too tightly, and resists any change the institution actually needs.

wheel.central_question: Should we win the conflict, or protect the people?

growth.label: Chancellor
growth.description: The quiet spine behind institutions; translates vision into something that survives contact with reality.
growth.guiding_promise: I will hold the center so the whole does not fall apart.
growth.shadow_description: Mistakes holding the center for holding on too tightly, and resists any change the institution actually needs.

other_ally.label: Inventor
other_ally.description: Curiosity-led; comfortable deciding by experiment rather than certainty.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will find a new way where the old ways have run out.
other_ally.shadow_description: Abandons every idea the moment a shinier one appears, and finishes nothing.

quarter.label: Aristocrat
quarter.description: Leads with inherited certainty and intuitive command.
quarter.guiding_promise: I carry the weight of legacy and lead with the confidence it bestows.
quarter.shadow_description: Mistakes inherited certainty for earned worth, and dismisses anyone without the pedigree to match.

opposite.label: Guardian
opposite.description: Loyal and protective; loss of the people they shield is the deepest fear.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will shield what I love, even when it costs me everything.
opposite.shadow_description: Protects so completely that the people they love never learn to stand on their own.

realmmate.label: Visionary
realmmate.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
realmmate.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

wheel.compatible_text: Visionary · Oracle — fellow travelers of The Mountain Belt.
